en.summary: This commit adds the missing workgroup-completion flush path so dirty D-cache state is pushed out before completion becomes visible on the master side.
why_it_counts: The patch changes warp scheduler, LSU, and top-level pipeline control, not tests or software.
It introduces a concrete memory-correctness mechanism tied to workgroup completion.
Without this path, external observers can see stale memory even though the GPU reports completion.
disqualifiers: The subject is phrased as an addition, so the bug-fix intent is inferred from the correctness mechanism rather than stated directly.
evidence: ventus/src/pipeline/warp_schedule.scala tracks per-workgroup end-program completion and raises io.flushDCache when a workgroup has drained.
ventus/src/pipeline/LSU.scala adds a flush_dcache decoupled path that issues a D-cache flush request and blocks normal FIFO intake while flushing.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When a GPU or accelerator declares a workgroup complete, any dirty private cache state associated with that work must already be written back or invalidated if completion is externally visible. If completion can retire before the local D-cache flush occurs, the host or another master can observe stale memory even though the computation has supposedly finished.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A workgroup finishes while its private data cache still contains dirty lines that must become visible to an external master or host.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Suppress the completion-to-flush handshake so the cache is not flushed when the workgroup retires.
portability_notes: Map this to any design where work completion must imply memory visibility beyond the local compute unit.
The bug can be injected either at the source of the completion event or at the LSU/cache interface that should launch the flush.
The best validation uses a kernel that writes data, finishes, and is then read by an external observer without an intervening full cache drain.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the logic that detects all threads or warps in a workgroup have finished.
Remove the signal that turns that completion condition into a D-cache flush request, or force that request to remain invalid.
Keep normal memory accesses working so the only regression is the missing flush at completion time.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Workgroup-end detection and flush_dcache handshake into LSU AddrCalculate
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds per-workgroup end tracking in warp_schedule, wires flushDCache through pipe.scala, and teaches AddrCalculate/LSU to issue a D-cache flush request when that handshake fires.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove warp_sche.io.flushDCache <> lsu.io.flush_dcache or force io.flushDCache.valid low in warp_schedule.scala.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Dirty D-cache lines survive past visible workgroup completion, so host-visible or master-visible memory reads can return stale data after the accelerator reports done.
evidence_for_injection: The scheduler now tracks workgroup completion with warp_endprg_cnt and warp_wg_valid specifically to decide when to flush.
LSU AddrCalculate adds a dedicated flush_dcache input and emits a flush opcode/param when is_flush is set.
Normal FIFO requests are blocked while the flush request is being handled, showing the flush is intended to serialize visibility at completion.
notes: This is a control-path correctness bug, not an arithmetic datapath issue.
For reinjection, breaking the scheduler-to-LSU flush handshake is the smallest mutation.

zh.summary: 该提交补上了 workgroup 完成时缺失的 D-cache flush 路径，使脏数据在完成状态对 master 侧可见之前先被推出缓存。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 warp scheduler、LSU 和顶层流水线控制，而不是测试或软件。
它引入了一个与 workgroup 完成直接相关的明确内存正确性机制。
缺少该路径时，即使 GPU 已上报完成，外部观察者仍可能读到陈旧内存。
disqualifiers: 提交标题写成了“新增”，因此其 bug-fix 含义需要从正确性机制本身推断。
evidence: ventus/src/pipeline/warp_schedule.scala 跟踪每个 workgroup 的 end-program 完成情况，并在 workgroup 清空时拉高 io.flushDCache。
ventus/src/pipeline/pipe.scala 将 warp_sche.io.flushDCache 连接到 lsu.io.flush_dcache。
ventus/src/pipeline/LSU.scala 新增了 flush_dcache 握手路径，用于发出 D-cache flush 请求，并在 flush 期间阻塞普通 FIFO 输入。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当 GPU 或加速器对外宣告一个 workgroup 已完成时，与该工作相关的本地脏缓存状态如果对外可见，就必须已经被写回或无效化。若 workgroup 可以在本地 D-cache flush 之前退休，那么 host 或其他 master 会在“已完成”的前提下仍然观察到陈旧内存。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 完成事件触发的缓存 flush
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个 workgroup 完成时，其私有数据缓存中仍有需要对外可见的脏 cache line。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 压制完成事件到 flush 请求之间的握手，使 workgroup 退休时不再触发缓存 flush。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何要求“工作完成”必须隐含本地缓存数据对外可见的设计。
该错误既可以在完成事件源头注入，也可以在 LSU/缓存侧接收 flush 请求的接口注入。
最佳验证方式是：kernel 先写数据并结束，再由外部观察者读取这些数据，中间不做全局缓存清空。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位检测某个 workgroup 内所有线程或 warp 均已结束的逻辑。
删除将该完成条件转换为 D-cache flush 请求的信号，或强制该请求始终无效。
保持普通内存访问功能不变，使唯一回归点是 workgroup 完成时漏掉 flush。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: workgroup 完成检测以及进入 LSU AddrCalculate 的 flush_dcache 握手
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复在 warp_schedule 中新增了每个 workgroup 的完成跟踪，在 pipe.scala 中接通了 flushDCache 信号，并让 AddrCalculate/LSU 在握手触发时发出 D-cache flush 请求。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 移除 warp_sche.io.flushDCache <> lsu.io.flush_dcache，或在 warp_schedule.scala 中强制 io.flushDCache.valid 为低。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 脏 D-cache line 会在 workgroup 完成后继续滞留，因此 host 或其他 master 在加速器上报完成后仍可能读到旧数据。
evidence_for_injection: scheduler 现在通过 warp_endprg_cnt 和 warp_wg_valid 跟踪 workgroup 完成，以决定何时 flush。
LSU 的 AddrCalculate 新增了专用 flush_dcache 输入，并在 is_flush 置位时输出 flush opcode/param。
普通 FIFO 请求在 flush 处理期间被阻塞，说明该 flush 旨在序列化 workgroup 完成时的可见性。
notes: 这是控制路径正确性问题，不是算术数据通路错误。
若做回注，最小化突变点是打断 scheduler 到 LSU 的 flush 握手。
